```sql
SELECT ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, a.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
JOIN pois a ON ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, a.geometry::geography, 50000)
WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%English Street Community Garden%'
  AND a.tourism = 'aquarium'
  AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%New Haven%'
  AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%CT%';
```

SELECT ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters

  AND r.region_name ILIKE '%Morton%'
  AND r.border_type = 'city'
  AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) < 80000;
